title: Existence of the tensorator for fixed scalar insertion at independent site sizes
statement: For essentially u-small sites (C,JC) and (D,JD) with independently sized object and morphism universes, let uInv be a finite-limit-preserving left adjoint between their sheaves of u-small sets. Let R, RI, S be commutative ring sheaves, I the specified algebraic inverse-image lift [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image], c:RI→S, and L the specified functor whose objects and maps are scalar extension of I along c. Construct scalarInsertion on sections by m↦η(1 tensor m), followed by hobj. There exists a natural family mu:L(M tensor_R N)≅L(M) tensor_S L(N), for the actual sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], satisfying the generalized pure-tensor formula with this fixed insertion. This asserts neither construction of insertion nor uniqueness of the tensorator.

source.place: Tag 03EL, lemma-tensor-product-pullback and its proof; scalar-extension insertion from Tags 03CY and 03D7.

proof.text: Apply the independently sized inverse-image tensor comparison to the specified algebraic inverse image. It supplies natural isomorphisms I(M tensor N) to I(M) tensor I(N) with their generalized pure-tensor formula. No scalar extension has yet been performed.

Construct the scalar-extension comparison on presheaf tensors by s tensor (m tensor n) maps to (s tensor m) tensor (1 tensor n), and construct its inverse by (s tensor m) tensor (t tensor n) maps to st tensor (m tensor n). The Lean proof descends the raw contraction through the two sheafification units using their adjunctions. Tensor induction, followed by the sheafification universal property, proves both inverse identities, naturality and the scalar-insertion formula. This entire step is proved in private helpers of the module.

Apply scalar extension to the first isomorphism, compose with the second, and conjugate by the object equalities hobj. Naturality of these two isomorphisms and the equation hmap give the required naturality for L. Their generalized pure formulas compose to the displayed formula with scalarInsertion. Degenerate modules and zero coefficient rings satisfy the same tensor identities; no flatness or nonzero hypothesis was used.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03EL, third Hom/Bilin equality followed by scalar extension
proof_origin.note: The inverse-image step is isolated; scalar extension, its two inverse identities, naturality, and assembly for L are implemented in Lean.

theorem normalizedTensorator_exists
    (uPush : Sheaf JD (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf JC (Type u))
    (adj : uInv ⊣ uPush) [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv]
    (hmap : ∀ {M N : SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)} (f : M ⟶ N),
      L.map f = eqToHom (hobj M) ≫
        changeOfRingsHom c (I.modules.obj M) (I.modules.map f) ≫ eqToHom (hobj N).symm) :
    ∃ mu : ∀ M N : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj
      R),
    L.obj ((monoidalCategory R).tensorObj M N) ≅
      (monoidalCategory S).tensorObj (L.obj M) (L.obj N),
      (∀ {M M' N N' : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u}
      RingCat.{u})).obj R)} (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N'),
    L.map ((monoidalCategory R).tensorHom f g) ≫ (mu M' N').hom =
      (mu M N).hom ≫ (monoidalCategory S).tensorHom (L.map f) (L.map g)) ∧
      ∀ (M N : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj
      R)) (Z : Sheaf JC (Type u))
    (x : Z ⟶ ((toSheaf ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R) ⋙
      sheafCompose JC
      (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})).obj M))
    (y : Z ⟶ ((toSheaf ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R) ⋙
      sheafCompose JC
      (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})).obj N))
    (z : Z ⟶ ((toSheaf ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R) ⋙
      sheafCompose JC
      (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})).obj
        ((monoidalCategory R).tensorObj M N))),
    (∀ (W : Cᵒᵖ) (t : Z.obj.obj W), z.hom.app W t =
      (tensorObjIsoSheafification M N).inv.val.app W
        (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u}
      RingCat.{u})).obj R).obj)).unit.app
          (M.val ⊗ N.val)).app W (x.hom.app W t ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj W] y.hom.app W t))) →
    ∀ (W : Dᵒᵖ) (t : (uInv.obj Z).obj.obj W),
      (uInv.map z ≫ I.moduleUnderlying.inv.app ((monoidalCategory R).tensorObj M N) ≫
        scalarInsertion R S RI uInv I c L hobj ((monoidalCategory R).tensorObj M N) ≫
          (toSheaf ((sheafCompose JD (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj S) ⋙ sheafCompose JD
            (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})).map (mu M N).hom).hom.app W t =
      (tensorObjIsoSheafification (L.obj M) (L.obj N)).inv.val.app W
        (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 ((sheafCompose JD (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u}
      RingCat.{u})).obj S).obj)).unit.app
          ((L.obj M).val ⊗ (L.obj N).val)).app W
            ((uInv.map x ≫ I.moduleUnderlying.inv.app M ≫ scalarInsertion R S RI uInv I c L hobj
              M).hom.app W t
              ⊗ₜ[S.obj.obj W]
              (uInv.map y ≫ I.moduleUnderlying.inv.app N ≫ scalarInsertion R S RI uInv I c L hobj
                N).hom.app W t))
